notes.title: English Version, Available Now!
notes.notes:
About to release v1.0.29 version
Multi-language versions of Demo and Playtest now live!
20230813

Updates:

1. The game now supports selectable languages, with two options to change the language settings:
(1) Login Screen - Language
(2) Settings Screen - Game Options

2. Comprehensive support for custom translations, along with translation support tools provided.
(1) The support tool can be accessed at Login Screen - Language - A Letter - Language Source File.
(2) Officially provided language source files are also included.
(3) The overall in-game text, including the storyline, has reached 180,000 words.

3. Currently available language versions include:
(1) Traditional Chinese繁体中文.
(2) The list of languages currently AI translated, with English translations having undergone simple proofreading, is as follows:
English
Deutsch
Español
Français
Italiano
Português
Tiếng Việt
Русский
日本語
한국어

4. Upon logging into Steam, the default language will be changed based on local language settings.
